study_identification_part.si4_title: Dissecting Heterogeneity in Functional Network Connectivity Aberrations in Antipsychotic Medication-Naïve First Episode Psychosis Patients - A Normative Modeling Study

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Characterize inter-individual heterogeneity in resting-state functional network connectivity and test whether normative values can help identify biologically less heterogeneous subgroups of antipsychotic-naïve first-episode psychosis patients.

rci1_dataset_name.answer: Normative model trained on ~22,000 healthy individuals across the lifespan (2–100 years); local healthy controls used for calibration.
rci1_dataset_name.reason: The paper explicitly states the approximate size and age span of the normative reference and that in-study HCs were used for calibration.
rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: The normative model was generated using resting state connectivity data from approximately 22,000 healthy individuals across the lifespan (age range (yrs): 2-100). Healthy control data collected in this project were used for calibration of the normative reference curves.

rci2_hc_n.reason: Table 1 clearly reports the HC sample size.

rci3_hc_age.reason: Table 1 lists HC age mean and SD.

rci4_hc_sex.reason: Table 1 lists male and female counts for HCs.

rci5_imaging_modality.reason: Methods describe acquisition of T1w and two rs-fMRI runs.
rci5_imaging_modality.supporting_text: A high-resolution T1-weighted structural scan was acquired ... Two resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI) runs were acquired ...

rci6_analysis_level.supporting_text: Functional brain networks were then parcellated using the Yeo-17 functional network parcellation atlas ... resulting in a functional connectivity matrix of 136 connectivity values.

rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.answer: FSL BET; FSL topup; CONN toolbox (21a); ART; aCompCor; ANTs (as-needed registration correction); band-pass 0.008–0.08 Hz; 4 mm FWHM smoothing; no global signal regression.
rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.reason: Image processing section details tools and steps used.
rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.supporting_text: T1-weighted images were skull-stripped using FSL BET ... corrected ... using FSL topup ... imported into the CONN toolbox (version 21a) ... Outlier volumes were censored using the ART toolbox ... aCompCor ... Global signal regression was not performed ... ANTs was used to correct the registration mistakes.

rci8_quality_checking.detail: >0.9 mm ART composite motion/censoring; exclude if mean FD >2 mm or >50% censored; registration issues corrected with ANTs.
rci8_quality_checking.supporting_text: ... ART ... (composite volume-to-volume motion >0.9 mm and global signal intensity >5SDs) ... scans with a mean framewise displacement >2mm or had >50% of censored data were excluded ... ANTs ... to correct the registration mistakes.

caa6_deviation_metric.supporting_text: We quantified functional connection deviations expressed as standard deviations (z-score) ... We binarized z-scores ... cut-off value of ±2 standard deviations.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Subgrouping by deviation profiles (positive-only, negative-only, mixed, none); FDR control (alpha=0.05); significance threshold of ≥4 deviations; subgroup vs overall similarity compared via z-test.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Functional network pathology is highly heterogeneous; deviation-based subgroups are less heterogeneous than the overall patient group.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: No more than 11.1% shared positive deviations and 8.3% shared negative deviations in the same connection. Forty-eight percent had no deviations. Deviation-defined subgroups showed reduced heterogeneity (positive subgroup: z = -2.88, p = 0.002; negative subgroup: z = -3.36, p < 0.001).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Global signal regression was not performed; deviation mapping may support precision-psychiatry subgrouping despite similar clinical presentations.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Normative reference likely overrepresents European ancestry, mismatching patient demographics; caution warranted when transferring models to diverse data.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Preprint on medRxiv (not peer-reviewed). Acquisition: Siemens 3T Prisma; two rs-fMRI runs with opposing PE; Yeo-17 atlas; connectivity matrix of 136 edges; ART censoring (>0.9 mm motion or >5 SD global signal); exclude if mean FD >2 mm or >50% censored; aCompCor nuisance regression; band-pass 0.008–0.08 Hz; 4 mm FWHM smoothing; ANTs used if registration issues; no global signal regression.
